name: controlled-agent-loop
explain: A five-phase controlled agent loop executes model prompting, tool extraction, schema validation, and bounded termination with loop/stagnation detection.
steps: Advance execution through explicit state machine phases. || Enforce hard limits on total iterations and context token consumption. || Detect repetitive argument oscillations and halt stagnant loops. || Return structured execution transcripts with explicit terminal outcomes.
expect: Controlled agent loop state machine and termination bounds verified successfully.

name: shared-hierarchical-budget
explain: Hierarchical budgets prevent multi-agent cost explosions by requiring child sub-agents to reserve bounded budget slices from the parent task pool.
steps: Allocate root task model call and financial ceilings. || Delegate bounded budget slices to child sub-agents using thread-safe reservation. || Atomically decrement consumption from the parent ledger and refund unused quotas on child termination.
expect: Hierarchical budget ledger, reservation slices, and refund mechanisms verified successfully.

name: sandboxed-code-executor
explain: Sandboxed Python execution inspects AST trees to block forbidden system modules and dangerous calls, executing code in restricted namespaces.
steps: Scan Abstract Syntax Trees before execution to reject forbidden module imports and dangerous builtins. || Detect and block reflection-based sandbox jailbreaks traversing object subclass hierarchies. || Execute approved code within restricted namespaces with captured and bounded output streams.
expect: Sandboxed code execution, AST security analysis, and jailbreak defense verified successfully.

name: durable-action-reconciliation
explain: Durable action logs record intent before external calls and reconcile uncertain in-flight states upon restart by querying downstream services by operation ID.
steps: Record durable PENDING intent records with idempotency keys before external tool dispatch. || Identify uncertain in-flight operations during post-crash harness restart scans. || Query downstream authoritative services to determine transaction status rather than repeating writes.
expect: Durable action logging and crash reconciliation verified successfully.

name: cooperative-cancellation-propagation
explain: Cooperative cancellation tokens propagate stop signals across distributed workers, distinguishing cleanly aborted tasks from committed side effects.
steps: Demonstrate that local coroutine cancellation does not abort background workers. || Pass cooperative cancellation tokens into workers to halt execution before next mutations. || Query downstream service state to confirm whether operations were aborted or committed.
expect: Cooperative cancellation tokens and external effect reconciliation verified successfully.

name: harness-events-telemetry-dashboard
explain: A strongly typed runtime event stream powers production observability dashboards, tracking completion rates, step latencies, and tool error rates.
steps: Emit typed lifecycle events during agent run execution. || Aggregate operational metrics across runs including success rates, average latency, and tool error percentages. || Provide structured dashboards for monitoring agent fleet health and budget burn.
expect: Harness runtime events, telemetry streaming, and production dashboard verified successfully.
